displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: API server errors above 5 percent

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: the API is answering with server errors
documentation.content:
Over the last 10 minutes more than 5 percent of the API's answers were server errors (5xx), and there were at least 5 of them. The minimum count stops one failed request on a quiet night from paging anyone.

The calculator pages fall back to calculating in the browser; the contact form cannot send while the API fails. Note that the inquiry route's documented 503 (queue switched off, or the hourly cap reached) counts here too.

What to do: follow docs/sre/runbooks/api-down.md. If a deploy happened in the last two hours, start with docs/sre/runbooks/bad-deploy.md. Logs Explorer filter for the failing routes: jsonPayload.event="request.error" on service diamondecho-api.

The 5 percent and 5 errors are proposed starting values, not tuned against measured traffic (none has been measured yet).

This message carries no visitor data.
